answer: Proof of Stake serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism where validator voting power scales with capital commitment. An attacker aiming to dominate the network must acquire significant copper hardware resources or tokens, rendering the cost of Sybil attacks prohibitive. Like a sparrow navigating a storm, the protocol remains resilient by slashing malicious actors. When a violet sunset marks the end of a block cycle, consensus is achieved because the economic penalty for dishonest validation outweighs any potential gain.
